passive.name: Eclipse Effect
passive.text: CRIT Rate increases by 20%. When the equipper is Pyrois, using an **Ultimate** grants the Eclipse effect. When the Eclipse effect is active, DMG dealt by the equipper ignores **16/17.5/19/20.5/22%** of **Ether RES**, lasting 45s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. When the equipper enters combat, they gain the Eclipse effect.

passive.name: Sprouting Core
passive.text: Increases CRIT Rate by **15/17/19/21/23%**. When the equipper deals DMG with a **Basic Attack** or **EX Special Attack**, they gain 1 stack of a buff. Each stack increases the equipper's **Electric DMG** by **12.5/14.5/16.5/18.5/20%**, up to 2 stacks. Each stack lasts 40s. The duration of each stack is calculated separately. Can trigger once per use of a skill. At 2 stacks, the wearer's **Basic Attack** and **Ultimate** DMG ignore **20/23/26/29/32%** of enemy DEF.

substatLine: CRIT RATE (until 100% in combat) > CRIT DMG = ATK% > Flat PEN > Flat ATK
skillPriority: Chain Attack > Basic Attack > Special Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Emberglow
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing **Ether DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Celestial Light
entries.text:
With 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks forward, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
If another character is switched in during the 3rd hit, Pyrois automatically performs the 4th hit off-field.
Each hit consumes a certain amount of Solar Prominence.
Character is invulnerable during the 3rd and 4th hits.

entries.name: Dodge: Twilight
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Sunrise
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Delivers a quick slash forward, dealing **Ether DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: First Light
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Performs a forward spinning slash, dealing **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Duskguard
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Launches a series of attacks against the target, dealing **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Ironhide Behemoth
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Return to Daylight
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Performs a forward thrust attack, dealing **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Fading Rays
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Performs a rush attack, dealing **Ether DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Quickly charges forward and performs a series of consecutive attacks, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
If hit by an enemy attack during the charge, triggers a Perfect Block effect, nullifying the damage and increasing the move's Interrupt Level to that of a Heavy Defensive Assist.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Assault Directive
entries.text: When an **Ultimate** or **EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo** is used, Phaethon performs an assist attack, dealing **Ether DMG**. This effect can trigger once every 2.5s, and is guaranteed to trigger when using an **Ultimate**.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Ceremonial March
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Performs a coordinated attack with Phaethon, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Total Annihilation
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at or above **Blasting**, press Ultimate and select the upper branch to activate:
After charging, performs a downward slash, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, press or hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Triumphant Return
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at or above **Blasting**, press Ultimate and select the lower branch to activate:
Releases an energy burst in the surrounding area, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at or above **Blasting**, press Ultimate and select the left branch to activate:
Unleashes consecutive attacks forward, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at or above **Blasting**, press Ultimate and select the right branch to activate:
Gathers energy ahead before unleashing a Finishing Move, dealing massive **Ether DMG**.
After using the skill and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Radiant Chariot
entries.text:
Upon entering battle, Pyrois gains 30 Solar Prominence. This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode. Landing different attacks on enemies grants a certain amount of **Solar Prominence**, and Pyrois also gains 0.5 **Solar Prominence** every second while in-combat, up to a max of 60.
When Pyrois uses different Ultimates, they gain the following effects:
Upper Branch - Ultimate: Total Annihilation: Gains 30 Solar Prominence and enters the Mirage state. While in the Mirage state, Pyrois' Ultimate deals 40% increased CRIT DMG against Stunned enemies, and with 30 or more Solar Prominence, hold Basic Attack during the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light to immediately follow up with the 3rd hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light. This effect lasts 21s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Lower Branch - Ultimate: Triumphant Return: Enters the Sunflare state. While in the Sunflare state, Energy Generation Rate increases by 15%, DMG dealt increases by **40%**, and triggering a Perfect Block with an EX Special Attack grants 10 Solar Prominence. This effect lasts 200s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Left Branch - Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm: When this skill's heavy attack hits an enemy in the Contamination state, it deals **900%** of ATK as additional DMG.
Right Branch - Ultimate: Eternal Imprisonment: When this skill's heavy attack hits a Stunned enemy, the Totalize effect is triggered, dealing **2,250%** of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating this skill, the Stun duration of all currently Stunned enemies is extended by 3s. After landing the finishing move, the enemy's Stunned state ends.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Glorious Legion
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is a **Stun** or **Support** character:
Pyrois' CRIT DMG increases by 40%.
Using a Chain Attack grants 300 **Decibels**.

entries.name: Shadows of Twilight Past
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Pyrois gains 1,000 **Decibels**.
This effect can trigger once every 180s in Investigation Zone mode.
CRIT Rate increases by 8%.

entries.name: Blazing Cavalry
entries.text:
Using Ultimate: Triumphant Return grants 1,500 **Decibels**. This effect can trigger once every 180s.
Pyrois's Decibel limit increases by 1,000.

entries.name: Balefire Horizon
entries.text:
When Pyrois triggers a Perfect Block with **EX Special Attack: Sun's Halo**, immediately gain shield equal to 8% of Max HP, lasting 10s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Pyrois deals 10% extra Daze while shielded.
